### Implemented UI Capabilities
1.  Renders the R3F boardroom as the primary operating scene.
2.  Treats five upper monitors as independent agent-owned canvases that render authoritative typed sessions or ambient identities based on state.
3.  Renders five lower apertures as distinct, nearly textless command instruments derived from live state.

### Claims Requiring Runtime Verification
1.  Idle upper monitors remain deliberately non-interactive.
2.  Legacy Hermes dashboard/CLI launchers are not upper-monitor ownership authority.
3.  Only a valid typed monitor session or live agent claim may activate a monitor workstation.
